title: Evaluation of the explicit additive scalar Hom map
statement: For a commutative ring Λ in Type(u+1), schemes W and S in universe u, k:W→S, a sheaf G of Λ-modules on the small etale site of W, q:ℕ, U:S.Etale, A:Over(W), and a raw derived Hom class z at A, rawModuleAbelianHomMap(Λ,k,G,q,U,A)(z) equals scalarSourceFactor(Λ,A.hom≫k,freeSheaf(Λ,S)(U),freeAbelian(S,U),freeMap(Λ,S,U)), followed by derived scalar forgetting applied to z, followed by scalarCoefficientFactor(Λ,A.hom,G,q). The factor definitions are the canonical ones of def-sbc-raw-scalar-source-factors and lem-sbc-raw-scalar-coefficient-square. Interpret the raw class values occurring in this equation at their native derived Hom types using the concrete identity views [def-sbc-raw-class-native-morphisms]; the elements and equality are unchanged.

proof.text: Unfold rawModuleAbelianHomMap. Its additive homomorphism is derived forgetting followed by right composition with the coefficient factor and left composition with the source factor. Evaluate AddCommGrpCat.ofHom and the two additive compositions. The canonical named factors have these exact bodies, so the equality is definitional (rfl). No coherence, invertibility or restriction on q beyond q:ℕ is used; zero classes, zero sheaves, identity maps and degree zero are included. Present raw class inputs and outputs at their native derived Hom types using the concrete identity functions in def-sbc-raw-class-native-morphisms. These return the input element itself; unfolding their identity bodies makes no mathematical change.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalarHom_evaluate
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A : Over W)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op A)) :
    rawAbelianClassMorphism (A.hom ≫ k)
      (restrictedOverCoefficient ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ W).obj G) A) q U
      (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A z) =
      scalarSourceFactor Λ (A.hom ≫ k) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeMap Λ S U) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (rawModuleClassMorphism Λ k G (q : ℤ) U A z) ≫
        scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G (q : ℤ)
lean.note: Presentation repair only: rawModuleClassMorphism and rawAbelianClassMorphism return their inputs at the definitionally equal derived Hom types. The mathematical statement, binders and degree conventions are unchanged.
